text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Thanks for your support♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Tokai... Teio...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo worked hard. And it's precisely 
because she worked so hard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gap was thrown into sharp relief. A 
divide so vast that mere effort couldn't 
bridge it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's the first crown! Next stop, the 
Derby♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers echoing in the distance. Twin Turbo 
watched Tokai Teio bathe in the applause—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stared blankly, as if gazing upon 
characters from a picture book.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Uuu... No way...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no! I don't really get it, but 
no, no, no, nooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is Teio's rival! We're in the same 
classroom, right next to each other! And 
yet!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, no way I'm gonna put up with 
this~~~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll win... I'll win, and Turbo 
will be on equal footing again.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo can try even harder! Yeah, Turbo can 
burn even hotter!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, things can go back to 
normal, right!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't bring myself to be confident. What 
we were born with is just too different. 
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo will do it! I'll show you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Teio! You just happened to 
get lucky today. Good for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo was endlessly innocent and 
positive. We just need to keep moving 
forward with single-minded focus.
